reviewer.note: docs/reviews/2026-11-08-undercroft-woodland-placed.md findings RT-1 to RT-3. Better than U5: the strands have volume and overlap with occlusion. RT-1 fault: rootlets are straight 1 to 2 px dark sticks splayed like legs, so the roots read as insects; taper them from 3 to 1 px, bend them, light their top side, make them fewer and uneven, tips under the floor. RT-2 fault: the stones are flat two-tone squares; three tones, a top plane and a contact line. RT-3 polish: no dark contact line where the strands meet the floor. Bar 0.60.
